newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD 50 KMS WALK CHAMPION KORZENIOWSKI.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD 50 KMS WALK CHAMPION KORZENIOWSKI.

text.p: Profile of Robert Korzeniowski, who won the world 50 kms walk title on Thursday.
Won the 50 kms walk bronze at the 1995 Gothenburg world championships after taking the 1991 and 1993 World University Games titles.
Set world best for five kms road walk in 1990.
Disqualified while lying in second place, and in the stadium, just before the finish of the 1992 Olympic 50 kms walk.
Compenstated four years later in Atlanta by taking the Olympic title.
A teacher by profession, he has set 13 national records over various distances and is a member of the French club US Tourcoing as well as his local Wawel Kracow club.
